papers.title: Scalable methylome-transcriptome profiling resolves clonal organization in human hematopoiesis
papers.abstract: Understanding human tissue maintenance and remodeling requires linking clonal ancestry to molecular state, yet scalable joint measurement remains challenging. Here, we introduce Droplet-MT and an integrated computational workflow for joint transcriptome and methylome profiling at ~10,000 cells per library. Methylation epimutations enable mutation-independent clonal reconstruction from high-coverage methylomes, while reference-based label transfer assigns cells to established clones at ~0.2% CpG coverage, reducing sequencing cost. Clone-aggregated somatic variants provide genetic annotation without additional single-cell genotyping. Across ~21,000 paired profiles from healthy blood and longitudinal acute myeloid leukemia, we resolved small and expanded clones with heterogeneous lineage output. In leukemia, the framework distinguished changes in malignant clonal abundance, state remodeling within persistent clones, and recovery of healthy polyclonal hematopoiesis. Malignant monocytes remained transcriptionally and epigenetically distinct from healthy and recovery-associated cells despite treatment-associated remodeling. Droplet-MT enables scalable analysis of human tissues by linking clonal organization with molecular state and retrospective genetic annotation.
papers.titleZh: 可擴展的甲基體與轉錄體分析解析人類造血系統中的株系組織
papers.summaryZh: 本研究介紹了 Droplet-MT 及其整合運算工作流程，可進行每個文庫約 10,000 個細胞的轉錄體與甲基體聯合分析。透過甲基化表觀突變與參考基準標籤轉移，該方法能在降低定序成本的同時，進行不需依賴突變的株系重建與細胞歸類。研究團隊在健康血液與縱向急性骨髓性白血病（acute myeloid leukemia）的約 21,000 個配對分析中，解析了具備異質性譜系產出的微小與擴增株系。在白血病中，此框架成功區分了惡性株系豐度的變化、持久株系內的狀態重塑，以及健康多株系造血系統的恢復。Droplet-KT 與此工作流程透過連結株系組織與分子狀態並提供回顧性基因註解，實現了人類組織的可擴展分析。

papers.title: Cellular and molecular census of the pleiotropic disease locus Negr1 in zebrafish
papers.abstract: A major challenge in precision medicine is to understand the cellular origin of disease-causing genetic alterations. One prominent example is the Negr1 locus, where common non-coding variants are associated with an unusually broad range of human traits and conditions, including body mass index (BMI), major depression, schizophrenia, autism-spectrum conditions and anorexia. Yet, no coding loss-of-function allele has been established as causal. These observations suggest that distinct Negr1-expressing cell populations underlie distinct traits. However, this hypothesis is difficult to test in tractable experimental systems without first determining where this gene may act. To overcome this limitation, we generated a knock-in reporter at the zebrafish Negr1 locus and combined single-cell transcriptomics with whole-brain registration and single-neuron projection mapping. We found that Negr1 is expressed in a graded manner across neuronal classes of the brain and retina, radial glia and astrocyte-like cells, and most consistently in oligodendrocyte progenitor cells. Projection mapping suggests three conserved hubs formed by olfactory bulb projection neurons, tectal periventricular projection neurons and cerebellar eurydendroid cells. Our findings are consistent with the idea that Negr1 pleiotropy arises from dose perturbation of a rather broadly expressed gene. More generally, this integrative approach to produce granular multimodal datasets should enable high-resolution etiological studies in models of human disease.
papers.titleZh: 斑馬魚中多效性疾病基因座 Negr1 的細胞與分子普查
papers.summaryZh: 本研究利用斑馬魚 Negr1 基因敲入報導體，結合單細胞轉錄體學、全腦配準與單神經元投射繪製，探討與多種人類性狀和疾病相關的 Negr1 基因座之細胞起源。研究發現 Negr1 在大腦與視網膜的神經元類別、放射狀神經膠質細胞、星形膠質細胞樣細胞，以及最一致的寡樹突膠質前驅細胞中呈現梯度表現。投射繪製結果顯示出由嗅球投射神經元、視蓋腦室周圍投射神經元與小腦樹突狀神經元形成的三個保守中樞。這些發現與 Negr1 的多效性源自廣泛表現基因的劑量擾動之觀點一致，且此整合性方法有助於在人類疾病模型中進行高解析度的病因學研究。

papers.title: Disrupted chromatin architecture blocks B lymphopoiesis in Down syndrome
papers.abstract: Human fetal haematopoiesis requires developmental potential to be encoded before lineage identity becomes transcriptionally apparent, but whether three-dimensional genome architecture provides such information is unknown. Here we develop ChromE-seq, a scalable single-cell assay that jointly profiles chromatin conformation and transcription, and integrate it with chromatin accessibility and DNA methylation to generate a multimodal atlas of ~400,000 haematopoietic cells from disomic and trisomy 21 (T21) human fetal liver. Chromatin contacts frequently preceded lineage-specific transcription or persisted after transcription declined, revealing 3D chromatin priming and memory. Unexpectedly, B-lineage and erythroid differentiation followed opposing architectural trajectories, with progressive loss and gain of chromatin connectivity, respectively. T21 disproportionately disrupted B-lineage architecture, redistributed interactions towards shorter genomic distances and weakened an EBF1-centred regulatory circuit. Deletion of a T21-sensitive EBF1 loop anchor reproduced the CLP-to-B-progenitor bottleneck observed in T21. These findings establish 3D genome architecture as an organizing layer of human fetal haematopoiesis that links developmental potential with lineage-specific vulnerability to genomic perturbation.
papers.titleZh: 染色體三維結構受損會阻礙唐氏症中的 B 細胞生成
papers.summaryZh: 本研究開發了 ChromE-seq 技術，並整合多體學數據建立了人類胎兒造血細胞的多模態圖譜，揭示三維基因體架構如何作為人類胎兒造血過程的組織層。研究發現染色體接觸經常先於或滯後於轉錄變化，展現出三維染色體啟動與記憶現象，且 B 譜系與紅血球分化遵循相反的架構軌跡。唐氏症（trisomy 21, T21）會不成比例地破壞 B 譜系架構、重新分佈交互作用並削弱以 EBF1 為中心的調節迴路。刪除對 T21 敏感的 EBF1 環狀錨點則能重現 T21 中觀察到的細胞分化瓶頸，說明三維基因體架構將發育潛能與基因組擾動下的譜系特異性脆弱性連結起來。

papers.title: A Unified Comparison of 10X Genomics and Parse Biosciences scRNA-seq Technologies
papers.abstract: Droplet-based and split-pool barcoding are the two dominant high-throughput single-cell RNA-seq paradigms, yet their systematic biases remain incompletely characterized. We compared seven matched 10X Genomics Chromium and Parse Biosciences Evercode WT sample pairs from five studies spanning multiple tissues and species focusing on gene counts and compositional differences rather than cell-type resolution. By separating Parse reads by priming strategy, we distinguished biases arising from priming chemistry from platform-level effects. These effects were largely independent, with platform-level differences substantially larger. Priming strategy introduced a GC-content bias within Parse, whereas the two platforms showed a consistent compositional shift across priming strategies, supported by differential capture of nuclear- and cytoplasmic-enriched transcripts. We interpret this shift as a relative enrichment of nuclear RNA in Parse. Finally, using contamination measures that do not assume a droplet-specific model, we found background RNA contamination in Parse to be comparable in magnitude to that in 10X, contrary to claims of substantially lower contamination. Together, these results indicate that expression measurements and cell-type composition are not directly interchangeable between the two platforms.
papers.titleZh: 10X Genomics 與 Parse Biosciences 單細胞 RNA 定序技術之統一比較
papers.summaryZh: 本研究系統性地比較了 10X Genomics Chromium 與 Parse Biosciences Evercode WT 兩種高通量單細胞 RNA 定序（scRNA-seq）技術，探討其系統性偏差。研究發現，引子策略會引入 GC 含量偏差，而平台層級的差異則更大，且兩平台展現出一致的組成偏移，推測與核 RNA 在 Parse 中的相對富集有關。此外，研究指出 Parse 的背景 RNA 汙染程度與 10X 相當，並非如先前宣稱般顯著較低。這些結果顯示，兩個平台的表達量測量結果與細胞類型組成並無法直接互換。

papers.title: GenDiMug: a generic inclusive multigraph framework to analyze genomic organizations and -omics data at multiple scales
papers.abstract: After decades of investigation, analyses of genome organization remain challenging. This is because genome descriptions are very information-rich and usually rendered as a linear map of genomic features corresponding to an ordered list of position intervals on a nucleic acid macromolecular backbone. This formalism, while accurate, is not fully optimized to mathematically analyze all genome structural properties, in particular the relations between genomic features, nor to integrate large amounts of -omics data, such as transcriptomes, epigenomes, proteomes, meltomes or chromatin accessibility data, which are increasingly available. We therefore developed GenDiMug, a tool that uses a network representation of the genome as a backbone, providing a natural framework to integrate spatial and ontogenetic relationships between genomic features and multi-omics data. We illustrate how this generic approach can be applied to all sorts of genomes, both to visualize genomic topology at contig and chromosomal scales at base-pair resolution, and to analyze genome positional effects using various graph metrics. Using GenDiMug, we further reveal clumping of genes with similar expression levels in eukaryotic genomes and their possible circadian regulation in a photosynthetic alga.
papers.titleZh: GenDiMug：一個能分析基因組組織與多體學資料的多尺度通用包容性多圖框架
papers.summaryZh: 本研究指出傳統基因組的線性地圖形式雖準確，但在數學分析基因組結構屬性與整合大量體學資料上並不完全最佳化。為此，作者開發了名為 GenDiMug 的工具，利用基因組的網路表示作為骨幹，提供一個自然框架來整合空間與個體發育關係以及多體學資料。此通用方法可應用於各類基因組，能以鹼基解析度視覺化重疊群與染色體尺度的基因組拓樸，並利用各種圖形指標分析基因組位置效應。研究團隊更進一步運用 GenDiMug，揭示了真核生物基因組中具有相似表現量基因的聚集現象，及其在光合藻類中可能的晝夜節律調控。

papers.title: Cause-excluded Effect Evaluation: a framework for the faithful assessment of genetic perturbation target identification
papers.abstract: Identifying which gene drives a desired cell-state transition is a foundational inverse problem in target discovery and cell-state engineering, yet far less developed than forward prediction. We show that prevailing benchmarks inflate performance through two artefacts: training leakage, where test-perturbation cells are seen during fitting, and evaluation leakage, where the perturbed gene's own expression change exposes the answer. Here, we introduce Cause-excluded Effect Evaluation (CEE), a framework that separates train and test perturbation targets, removes target-gene self-effects from expression profiles and scores candidates in downstream response space. With CEE, we find that simple structure-based methods consistently outperform complex deep learning models across 16 single-cell perturbation datasets, revealing that the recoverable signal is governed by low-rank and additive structure in perturbation responses rather than by model complexity. Our work disentangles evaluation artefacts from genuine predictive capacity and offers a design principle for developing perturbation target identification methods.
papers.titleZh: 排除因果效應評估：基因擾動標的識別忠實評估的框架
papers.summaryZh: 本研究指出現有基準測試因訓練洩漏與評估洩漏而高估了表現，並為此引入了「排除因果效應評估」（Cause-excluded Effect Evaluation, CEE）框架，以分離訓練與測試擾動標的、移除標的基因自身表達效應，並在下游反應空間中評估候選者。利用 CEE，研究發現在 16 個單細胞擾動數據集中，簡單的基於結構的方法持續優於複雜的深度學習模型，顯示可恢復的訊號受擾動反應中的低秩與加法結構所主導。此工作釐清了評估人工產物與真實預測能力之間的差異，並為開發擾動標的識別方法提供了設計原則。

papers.title: Perturb-Seqr: Signature Search Engine Integrating Connectivity Mapping Resources
papers.abstract: High-throughput transcriptomics can be used to develop Connectivity Mapping resources for identifying potential reversers and mimickers of disease signatures for drug and target discovery. Recently, several new Connectivity Mapping datasets have emerged, but no efforts were made so far to evaluate and integrate them. Motivated by this opportunity, we have developed Perturb-Seqr, a comprehensive Connectivity Mapping search engine that integrates nine small molecule transcriptomics Connectivity Maps and seven single gene perturbation followed by expression Connectivity Maps. Specifically, Perturb-Seqr contains processed data from LINCS (L1000), Tahoe-100M, Novartis Institute for Biomedical Research (DRUG-seq), the original CMap (cDNA microarrays), Ginkgo Bioworks (DRUG-seq), SciPlex (scRNA-seq), DeepCover MoA (PISA proteomics), Perturb Atlas (RNA-seq), Replogle et al. (Perturb-seq), CREEDS (cDNA microarrays), CM4AI (Perturb-seq), and RummaGEO (RNA-seq). To serve these Connectivity Maps in one unifying search engine, we converted the expression signatures from these resources into 450,271 gene sets of up- and down-regulated genes measuring the effects of 9,856 unique drug and 17,643 unique gene perturbations, targeting 917 cell lines and cell types. We demonstrate how Perturb-Seqr, and the gene sets it serves, can be used to identify targets for drugs and drugs for targets, uncover new pathways, and identify potential side effects for preclinical compounds. Overall, Perturb-Seqr is a comprehensive up-to-date Connectivity Mapping search engine and database, enabling the discovery of new drugs and targets. Perturb-Seqr is accessible from: https://perturbseqr.maayanlab.cloud/.
papers.titleZh: Perturb-Seqr：整合連對應資源的特徵搜尋引擎
papers.summaryZh: 本研究開發了 Perturb-Seqr，這是一個綜合性的連對應（Connectivity Mapping）搜尋引擎與資料庫，旨在整合多種小型分子與單一基因擾動的轉錄體學資源。研究團隊將來自多個來源的表現特徵轉換為數十萬個基因集，涵蓋多種藥物、基因擾動以及細胞株與細胞類型。此搜尋引擎可用於識別藥物標靶、尋找標靶藥物、揭示新途徑並識別臨床前化合物的潛在副作用，進而推動新藥與標靶的發現。

papers.title: An automated operon refactoring workflow for heterologous expression of non-ribosomal peptide biosynthetic gene clusters
papers.abstract: Existing approaches for biosynthetic gene cluster (BGC) discovery are labor-intensive, depend on de novo DNA synthesis and are difficult to scale. Here we show that an automated platform for one-step assembly and refactoring of BGCs facilitates facile novel product discovery.
papers.titleZh: 應用於非核糖體肽生合成基因簇異源表現之自動化操縱子重構工作流程
papers.summaryZh: 現有的生合成基因簇（biosynthetic gene cluster, BGC）發現方法多半勞力密集、依賴從頭 DNA 合成且難以擴展。本研究展示了一個用於 BGC 一步式組裝與重構的自動化平台，有助於簡化新穎產物的發現。此平台克服了過去方法的限制，提升了研究效率。

papers.title: In situ reduction-driven formation of sub-nanometer alternating heterostructures
papers.abstract: Sub-nanometer heterostructures offer opportunities to tune interfacial reactivity, but their precise construction remains challenging. Here, the authors report alternating Ni/NiMoO₄ heterostructures that promote hydrogen evolution and sustain durable high-current electrolysis.
papers.titleZh: 原位還原驅動亞奈米交替異質結構的形成
papers.summaryZh: 亞奈米異質結構為調節界面反應活性提供了機會，但其精確建構仍然深具挑戰。本研究報告了交替的 Ni/NiMoO₄ 異質結構，此結構能促進氫氣析出並維持持久的高電流電解。這項成果有助於克服精確建構亞奈米異質結構的挑戰，並展現出促進產氫與耐用高電流電解的潛力。

papers.title: A supergene and genomic mosaicism are associated with phenotypic evolution in Galápagos tree finches
papers.abstract: Adaptive radiations produce striking phenotypic diversity over remarkably short evolutionary timescales. This study uses genomic analyses of Darwin’s tree finches to reveal a cryptic lineage, in which autosomal differentiation with another sympatric species is restricted primarily to a single locus (G03) that approaches fixation, shifting them from one phenotypic optimum to another.
papers.titleZh: 超級基因與基因體鑲嵌現象與加拉巴哥樹雀的表現型演化有關
papers.summaryZh: 本研究利用達爾文樹雀的基因體分析，揭示了一個隱蔽的譜系，其與另一同域物種的體染色體分化主要受限於單一趨近固定的基因座（G03），使牠們從一個表現型最適點轉移到另一個最適點。這項發現有助於理解適應性輻射如何在極短的演化時間尺度內產生顯著的表現型多樣性。

paper.title: A method quantifying soil melanin to understand fungal impacts on soil carbon stability
paper.abstract: A method developed to directly measure fungal melanin in soil, reveals a strong link between melanin and soil carbon and providing evidence for its role in long-term carbon stabilization

paper.title: Intensification of near-inertial currents in the Atlantic Ocean over the past two decades
paper.abstract: Ocean drifter observations reveal that Atlantic near-inertial currents intensified by almost 4% per decade during 2003–2022. This intensification is primarily driven by changes in wind forcing associated with mesoscale weather systems.

paper.title: HCV incidence and prevalence trends among people who use drugs in France 2004 to 2023
paper.abstract: Authors show in 2013-2023 France saw a substantial reduction in hepatitis C virus prevalence and incidence among people who use drugs. Widespread treatment and harm reduction drove the decline, bringing France closer to WHO 2030 elimination targets.

paper.title: Asymmetric bloom lengthening drives high-latitude ocean chlorophyll accumulation imbalance
paper.abstract: This study shows that unequal changes in bloom duration between hemispheres contribute to contrasting high-latitude ocean chlorophyll trends, linking asymmetric phytoplankton phenology to marine ecosystem changes under climate warming.

paper.title: Time-lapse RESOLFT nanoscopy empowered by deep learning
paper.abstract: The authors use two deep-learning methods for RESOLFT nanoscopy: HDN denoising enables five-fold longer live-cell imaging, while spatial upsampling with temporal context restores subsampled data for fourfold higher frame rates and reduced artifacts.
